quests.name: Trouble with Bats
quests.summary: The banker wants the bat near Uludale thinned out.
intro: The bat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Uludale and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Raw Lobster
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Uludale has run out of raw lobster.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 21 raw lobster and nobody in Uludale has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Uludale to the archery shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the archery shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the food shop keeper of Uludale and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the food shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Uludale Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Uludale Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Uludale Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Giant Rats
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper wants the giant rat near Uludale thinned out.
intro: The giant rat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Uludale and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Armour Shop Keeper

Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Uludale Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Uludale Sewers and tell the magic shop keeper.
intro: Uludale Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the magic shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Uludale owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Uludale Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Orandale
quests.summary: Gather raw lobster for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Orandale.
intro: I have an order from Orandale and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 raw lobster, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Uludale.
From Uludale? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Uludale and bring back mithril ore.
intro: The wilds around Uludale need a firm hand. Start with 13 giant rat outside the walls, then 21 king scorpion down in Uludale Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 21 mithril ore to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Uludale for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the staff shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the banker does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the staff shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

When that is done, bring me 26 maple logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Uludale for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the fishing shop keeper, fight your way through 31 bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 21 raw lobster back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Uludale: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Uludale Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Uludale and Orandale.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Orandale. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 spider near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Uludale.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Orandale is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Uludale has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Uludale
quests.summary: Find what rules Uludale Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Plague Warden.
intro: Something rules Uludale Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the magic shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Uludale is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Plague Warden.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Plague Warden is dead. Uludale Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
